Tests application of correct specimen collection principles for catheterised patients and the invalidity of drainage bag specimens, anchored after block 5 which details specimen methods and significance thresholds; inspired by micro_quiz pool-1.

Tests visual recognition of the three major bacterial STI organisms' microscopic appearances matched to their characteristic clinical presentations, anchored after block 7 which covers bacterial STI pathogenesis and laboratory diagnosis.

Tests understanding of the HSV latency–reactivation cycle including the anatomical site of latency and the mechanism of progressively milder recurrences, anchored after block 9 which details HSV pathogenesis and clinical features.
